key_insight: ViBMR introduces a large-scale dataset pairing multi-sequence brain MRI with routine Vietnamese reports to support report-generation research in a low-resource clinical language.
clinical_relevance: The resource could support research toward reducing radiologists’ reporting workload, but clinical reliability is not established by the abstract.
method: Pair brain MRI studies with routine Vietnamese clinical reports.
Include T1, T2, FLAIR, and contrast-enhanced T1 sequences.
Evaluate representative medical vision-language models, multi-sequence inputs, and feature aggregation strategies.
evidence_signal: The dataset contains 3,649 patients and 11,875 MRI series; the abstract describes comprehensive benchmarking but reports no numerical performance results.
watch_item: Generalizability and clinical safety require further validation before use in patient care.
paper_title: ViBMR: A Large-Scale Multi-Sequence Brain MRI Dataset and Comprehensive Evaluation for Vietnamese Radiology Report Generation
